standard: 5 = quantified increase in delivered cargo/tissue level/dose-sparing against a stated external baseline; 4 = novel platform/shuttle/chemistry with concrete loading or uptake relevance but no baseline-anchored number; 3 = mechanistic, established-platform, conventional-chemistry, non-antibody-specific nanoparticle or degrader-readout work; ties break downward; reviews capped at 2.

articles.title: Targeted lipid nanoparticles containing IL-10 mRNA improve outcomes in experimental intracerebral hemorrhage.
articles.rationale: Abstract states VCAM-LNPs reached brain ~4x more than nonspecific LNPs, a baseline-anchored delivered-amount figure (10x expression is secondary).

articles.title: HER2 Antibody-Nanogel Conjugates: A High-Capacity, Antibody-Sparing Alternative to Antibody-Drug Conjugates.
articles.rationale: Equal xenograft efficacy to T-DM1 with 4-fold less antibody, attributed to higher DAR; dose-sparing against an external clinical comparator.

articles.title: High-payload trastuzumab-drug conjugates achieved through hydrophilic Y-shaped pendant PEG linkers for a potent and selective antitumor response.
articles.rationale: DAR 8 against the stated DAR 4 ceiling with intact payload, plus tumor accumulation and efficacy; DAR increase with functional consequence.

articles.title: Utilizing biorecognition to prime tumors for enhanced nanomedicine delivery of alpha therapies.
articles.rationale: Tumor retention of 212Pb nanomedicine more than tripled versus untargeted nanomaterial by SPECT and gamma counting.

articles.title: A first-in-class precision antibody conjugate targeting EGFR, mTOR, and PI3K to treat head and neck cancers.
articles.rationale: New BAC linker gives homogeneous DAR 8 with preserved function, but no baseline DAR or delivery comparator is stated; efficacy is versus free drug and cetuximab.

articles.title: Chemically Masked aPD-L1-Sialidase Conjugate for Tumor-Specific Desialylation and Immunotherapy.
articles.rationale: 9.3-fold tumor accumulation and 144-fold half-life extension versus unmasked control, both stated in the abstract.

articles.title: A binding-to-release strategy for targeted anticancer drug delivery.
articles.rationale: 5.9-fold higher tumor MMAE AUC and 14.7-fold tumor-to-blood ratio versus internalization-dependent SMDC; measured delivered payload.

articles.title: Enhancing the efficacy of siRNA Antibody Oligonucleotide Conjugates (AOCs) through chemical design
articles.rationale: DAR2-C16 AOC needs half the antibody for equal knockdown at 1 mg/kg siRNA versus DAR1-C16; stated dose-sparing with higher loading.

articles.title: Bispecific antibodies that engage pIgR enrich in mucosa in cynomolgus monkeys.
articles.rationale: pIgR bispecifics enrich 5-10-fold in bronchoalveolar lavage versus normal IgG in cynomolgus monkeys; quantified transit with baseline.

articles.title: CD7-Specific Polymersomal Vincristine Delivery Potentiates Chemotherapy in T‑Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia.
articles.rationale: Nanobody-decorated polymersomes with no delivered-cargo measurement; targeted nanoparticle without antibody-specific delivery insight.

articles.title: Metal-phenolic network-based polymeric nanocarriers facilitating antibody cytoplasmic delivery and anti-tumor effects to orthotopic breast tumors
articles.rationale: Antibody-as-cargo metal-phenolic carrier with endosomal escape is a novel platform; no baseline-anchored delivery number in abstract.

articles.title: A facile chemical strategy to synthesize precise AAV-protein conjugates for targeted gene delivery.
articles.rationale: Genetic-code-expansion click chemistry controls nanobody copy number and site on AAV; novel conjugation, no quantified delivery baseline.

articles.title: An archaeal protein nanoparticle platform for cancer cell-specific targeting and therapeutics
articles.rationale: New gas-vesicle platform displaying multiple antibodies and ADCs at high density; valency architecture, no delivery number.

articles.title: Cell-penetrating antibody enhances nuclear delivery of triplex-forming oligonucleotides targeting HER2-positive cancers.
articles.rationale: Cell-penetrating antibody 3E10 D31N carrying TFOs to nuclei is a concrete uptake platform; 'superior' delivery is not quantified.

articles.title: Targeted Delivery of VEGF-siRNA to Glioblastoma Using Orientation-Controlled Anti-PD-L1 Antibody-Modified Lipid Nanoparticles.
articles.rationale: Novel Fc-binding-peptide orientation chemistry; ~50-fold uptake is versus unnamed 'controls', so not baseline-anchored enough for 5.

articles.title: Nanobody conjugated with dendrimer nanoparticles effectively neutralizes tick-borne encephalitis virus.
articles.rationale: Nanobody-dendrimer/Angiopep BBB passage shown in a model only with no quantified cargo transit; conventional carrier chemistry.

articles.title: Improved biodistribution and antitumor effects of a Nectin4 and Trop2 bispecific fatty acid-modified nanobody conjugate.
articles.rationale: Fc-free bispecific nanobody-drug conjugate with fatty-acid half-life tuning is a new format; no baseline-anchored uptake number.

articles.title: Novel single-domain antibodies targeting a unique transferrin receptor 1 epitope for cross-species delivery of drugs in the central nervous system.
articles.rationale: New cross-species TfR1 VHH epitope with affinity-transcytosis link; brain uptake only 'improved vs irrelevant control', no figure.

articles.title: Remodeling Cellular Uptake via Inducing Clustering of Urokinase Receptors in Hydrogel Microspheres for Alleviating Cartilage Senescence.
articles.rationale: Anti-uPAR liposomes show 1.7-2-fold in vitro and 1.5-fold in vivo uptake versus untargeted Lipo-Sirt6, via antibody-induced receptor clustering.

articles.title: Cell-specific mRNA delivery via nanobody-functionalized lipid nanoparticles.
articles.rationale: Site-specific click nanobody-LNP platform with transcytosis claim; uptake enhancement not quantified in abstract.

articles.title: Improved targeted delivery of antisense oligonucleotide with an antibody mask.
articles.rationale: Anti-ASO antibody mask on TfR-ASO conjugates is a novel format improving uptake qualitatively; no fold-change.

articles.title: Modular Assembly of Lipid Nanoparticles for Targeted mRNA Therapeutics and Vaccines.
articles.rationale: Monomeric streptavidin-Fc-binder platform for modular LNP antibody docking; 98% T-cell transfection has no comparator.

articles.title: A multivalent nanobody-drug conjugate to prevent and treat influenza virus infections.
articles.rationale: VHH-Zan4 about 10-fold more potent than single-copy VHH-Zan1; payload copies per nanobody raised with retained function and protection.

articles.title: Modular Platform for Therapeutic Drug Delivery Using Trifunctional Bio-Orthogonal Macromolecular Conjugates.
articles.rationale: Trifunctional antibody-CPP-cargo conjugates show endosomal escape and Cas9 delivery; novel platform, no baseline number.

articles.title: Fc-Modified IVIG with Enhanced Blood-Brain Barrier Penetration Ameliorates Cognitive Deficits and Neuropathology in A53T α-Synuclein Transgenic Mice.
articles.rationale: Site-specific Angiopep-2 on IVIG Fc glycan drives LRP1 transcytosis; 'significantly higher' brain accumulation is unquantified.

articles.title: Balancing brain exposure, pharmacokinetics and safety of transferrin receptor antibodies for delivery of neuro-therapeutics.
articles.rationale: Systematic affinity/valency/epitope scan is design-rule mechanistic work without a new platform or stated delivery figure.

articles.title: High-Throughput Screening of Photo-Cross-Linking Peptide Libraries for Site-Specific Conjugation of IgG.
articles.rationale: Screened Fc-binding photo-cross-linking peptide is new site-specific chemistry; yield figure is versus authors' own earlier peptide and not delivery.

articles.title: Transferrin receptor-binding blood-brain barrier shuttle enhances brain delivery and plaque-clearing efficacy of a therapeutic anti-Aβ antibody.
articles.rationale: TfR1 Fab shuttle achieved plaque reduction at five-fold lower dose than unmodified aducanumab, an external dose-sparing baseline.

articles.title: Preparation and in vitro functional validation of a novel antibody-siRNA-Exatecan conjugate (AREC).
articles.rationale: Antibody-siRNA-exatecan conjugate at DAR 1-2 supported by in vitro killing only; no delivery or PK readout.

articles.title: Engineering HLA-G-targeted extracellular vesicles nanoplatform for enhanced cancer therapy through precise cancer drug delivery.
articles.rationale: VHH-displaying EVs are a targeted nanoparticle with efficacy-only readouts and no delivered-cargo measurement.

articles.title: The NewroBus platform: engineered humanized anti-TfR1 nanobodies for efficient brain delivery.
articles.rationale: Humanized picomolar TfR1 nanobody shuttle crosses BBB without blocking transferrin; novel shuttle, no baseline-anchored uptake figure.

articles.title: Tumor mRNA-lipid nanoparticles via chimeric nanobody-lipid co-assembly.
articles.rationale: One-step palmitoylated-nanobody/lipid co-assembly gives PEG-free targeted LNP; improved delivery claimed qualitatively.

articles.title: Effect of Endocytosis Inhibitors on the Cytotoxicity and Antitumor Activity of Anti-GD2 ADCs.
articles.rationale: Nystatin raises anti-GD2 ADC accumulation and lowers IC50 1.5-2.5-fold in vitro but not in vivo; mechanistic insight only.

articles.title: Multivalent Atezolizumab-Liposome Conjugates as Active Immunotherapeutic Platforms for Enhanced PD-L1 Blockade in Melanoma.
articles.rationale: Ligand density tunes avidity and retention on liposomes, but readouts are binding and blockade, not delivered cargo.

articles.title: Targeting DNA-LNPs to Endothelial Cells Improves Expression Magnitude, Duration, and Specificity.
articles.rationale: First antibody/Fab-targeted DNA-LNPs to endothelium; results are expression magnitude versus untargeted, no delivered-amount figure.

articles.title: Development and Optimization of an Aminooxy Coupling Reaction to Prepare Multivalent Bioconjugates with a Single Noncanonical Amino Acid.
articles.rationale: New aminooxy/Glaser-Hay bioorthogonal chemistry yields trivalent drug-plus-probe antibody conjugates; no loading consequence quantified.

articles.title: Engineering Elastin-Like Peptide-Based Nanoparticles displaying Variable Domain of the Heavy Chain of Heavy-Chain-Only Antibodies for SARS-CoV-2 Neutralization.
articles.rationale: VHH-ELP nanoparticle valency tuning improves neutralization potency, not cargo delivery or uptake.

articles.title: Staufen dsRNA-binding domain as modules to design bifunctional antibodies for siRNA delivery.
articles.rationale: Non-covalent Staufen dsRBD antibody-siRNA 1:1 pairing is a novel carrier; 7-fold silencing is function, and in vivo stability failed.

articles.title: Loading Density Influences the Tumor Cell Targeting and Signaling Inhibition Capabilities of Antibody Nanoconjugates.
articles.rationale: Loading-density comparison (~60 vs ~170 Ab/NS, ~2x avidity) on an established nanoshell is mechanistic and not a delivery measurement.

articles.title: Targeted Delivery of Nucleic Acid and Protein Cargos into Primary Human Hematopoietic Stem Cells Using Bacteriophage T4.
articles.rationale: Antibody-displaying T4 phage nanoparticle co-delivers mRNA and protein to primary HSCs; novel platform, 20% efficiency has no comparator.

articles.title: Preparation of Targeted Lipid Nanoparticles by Insertion of Either Tetrazine-trans-Cyclooctene or Thiol-Maleimide Micelles.
articles.rationale: Tetrazine-TCO versus maleimide antibody insertion into LNPs; 97% GFP+ is expression versus unspecified controls.

articles.title: Intravenous Delivery of a Gene Therapy Vector that Expresses an Antitransferrin Receptor 1 Nanobody-I2S Fusion Protein Rescued Central Nervous System Lysosomal Burden in Mucopolysaccharidosis II Mice.
articles.rationale: N-terminal TfR1-VHH-I2S AAV fusion beats C-terminal and untagged I2S on CNS GAG clearance; qualitative, expression-based.

articles.title: Systemic and Local Delivery of siRNA to the CNS and Periphery via Anti-IGF1R Antibody Conjugation
articles.rationale: IGF1R antibody shuttle for siRNA is a new shuttle receptor with in vivo knockdown; no comparator figure.

articles.title: Enabling the synthesis of multi-payload thio-antibody conjugates through the use of pyridazinediones, p-anisidine derivatives and various click chemistries.
articles.rationale: Pyridazinedione platform gives defined payload-to-antibody ratios 1-8 and multi-payload loading; characterized with fluorophores only.

articles.title: Unlocking binding properties of single-domain antibodies targeting the polymeric immunoglobulin receptor to enhance mucosal enrichment of IgG against respiratory syncytial virus.
articles.rationale: Anti-pIgR VHH transcytosis comparable to dimeric IgA with pH-dependent off-rate link; new shuttle, no in vivo figure.

articles.title: Site-Specific Glycan Conjugation Improves Stability and Efficacy of an Antibody-Drug Conjugates Bearing DXd as a Cytotoxic Payload.
articles.rationale: Fc glycan site-specific DAR 4 DXd ADC outperforms a DAR 8 cysteine ADC in vivo; novel chemistry, no delivery number.

articles.title: In Vivo Comparison of Site-Specific and Site-Selective Methods for Pretargeted Imaging in a Murine Model of Colorectal Cancer.
articles.rationale: Compares stochastic versus site-specific TCO loading with 10.4 %ID/g top uptake; comparator values for other arms not in abstract.

articles.title: Multibody-Enabled Lysosome-Targeting Drug Conjugates for Target Protein Degradation and Combination Therapy
articles.rationale: Multibody LYTAC drug conjugate readout is receptor degradation and efficacy; degrader work, no delivered-cargo number.

articles.title: Universal functionalization of extracellular vesicles with nanobody adapters
articles.rationale: NaTaLi nanobody-adapter EV display enables plug-and-play multi-ligand loading; tumor delivery reported qualitatively.

articles.title: CD44-Assisted Transcytosable Chimeras for Extracellular Protein Depletion in Deep Tumors.
articles.rationale: CD44 transcytosis degrader chimeras are measured by target depletion; degrader readout, not delivered cargo.

articles.title: Balancing Multivalent Avidity and Receptor Availability Governs mRNA Delivery by Antibody-Functionalized Lipid Nanoparticles.
articles.rationale: VHH-LNP platform with quantified bell-shaped ligand-density optimum (~0.1 VHH/100 nm2); strong design rule but no delivered-cargo baseline.

articles.title: Receptor-ubiquitination-targeting antibody-drug conjugates for enhanced endocytosis and lysosomal delivery.
articles.rationale: E3-recruiting ADC to accelerate endocytosis and lysosomal delivery is a novel uptake lever; no uptake fold-change stated.

articles.title: In Vivo Auto-tuning of Antibody-Drug Conjugate Delivery to Maximize Efficacy Using High-Avidity, Low-Affinity Antibodies.
articles.rationale: Co-dosed high-avidity low-affinity antibody tunes ADC penetration and uptake; novel strategy, improvement not quantified in abstract.

articles.title: Ionizable Polymeric Micelles Targeting Transferrin Receptor 1 Enhance Systemic mRNA Delivery to the Brain.
articles.rationale: TfR1 Fab-micelle ~10-fold brain expression is versus the authors' own initial formulation and measures expression, not cargo.

articles.title: NN-800s: Brain-penetrant trimeric nanobodies enable potent TNFα inhibition via TfR1-mediated transcytosis
articles.rationale: Trimeric TfR1/TNF nanobody gives CSF-to-serum ~0.4 but with no baseline comparator; novel format.

articles.title: Multispecific nanobody degraders co-deplete membrane receptors and enable targeted delivery of diverse payloads.
articles.rationale: Trispecific nanobody-Fc with TfR1 uptake arm carries ADC and degrader payloads; potency readouts, no delivered-amount baseline.

articles.title: Post-Conjugation Process for Antibody-Conjugated Lipid Nanoparticles Enabling Tunable Antibody Surface Density for Targeted RNA Delivery.
articles.rationale: Post-conjugation process tunes antibodies per LNP (~340/760/1200) with in vivo bone-marrow gain over control LNP, unquantified.

articles.title: Harnessing TfR1 for Cross-Species Systemic Delivery of siRNAs to Deep Brain Regions Using Single-Domain Antibodies
articles.rationale: TfR1 VHH-siRNA 1:1 conjugates give 50-80% knockdown, ED50 <1 mg/kg in mice and NHP; no comparator.

articles.title: Balancing Affinity and Chelator Density: Random Versus Site-Specific Single-Domain Antibody Radiolabeling for PET imaging of B7-H3 expressing tumors
articles.rationale: Site-specific versus random sdAb radiolabeling gave comparable tumor uptake (3.7 vs 3.4 %IA/g); no delivery gain.

articles.title: Orthogonal Conjugation via Endoglycosidase and Microbial Transglutaminase Enables Efficient Synthesis of Dual-Payload Antibody-Drug Conjugates.
articles.rationale: Orthogonal mTG plus Endo-S2 chemistry installs two payloads at Fc sites; dual-payload loading route, no delivery data.

articles.title: An intrinsically hydrophilic linker enables a stable, high-DAR exatecan-based HER2 ADC with potent antitumor activity.
articles.rationale: Hydrophilic linker gives DAR 7.92 with <1% aggregation, but DAR matches existing T-DXd-class loading; no delivery-baseline number.

articles.title: Impact of ASO conjugation and receptor binding affinity on intracellular transport of mono- and bispecific TfR- and CD98-BrainshuttleTM variants.
articles.rationale: Shows ASO conjugation shifts TfR1 shuttle avidity and delays transcytosis; mechanistic insight in vitro only.

articles.title: pIgR Stem Zone-Targeted Nanobodies as Apical-to-Basolateral Carriers for Inhaled Biologic Delivery Across Mucosal Barriers.
articles.rationale: Inhaled pIgR-stem bispecific was effective at one-tenth the reslizumab dose while reslizumab alone failed; baseline-anchored dose-sparing.

articles.title: CD98hc-targeted antibody shuttles for central nervous system delivery with broad cross-species reactivity.
articles.rationale: Active-learning cross-species CD98hc shuttles with long-lived brain delivery; new shuttle, no brain-uptake figure in abstract.

articles.title: High-payload antibody-oligonucleotide-drug conjugates (AODC) for targeted tumor chemo-immunotherapy.
articles.rationale: Oligonucleotide-like prodrug chains expand payload per antibody; high-capacity loading concept, no DAR figure given.

articles.title: pH-dependent anti-TfR1 NANOBODY® molecules deliver efficacious oligonucleotide payloads to muscle and CNS tissues
articles.rationale: pH-dependent cross-reactive TfR1 nanobody shuttles; knockdown percentages lack a comparator.

articles.title: Development of a Polypeptide-Based Platform to Construct Antibody-Drug Conjugates with High Potency.
articles.rationale: Polypeptide backbone reaches DAR up to 61 with retained binding, endocytosis and PK, but no explicit comparator DAR.

articles.title: Delivery of small interfering RNA and antisense oligonucleotides across the blood-brain barrier with monovalent transferrin receptor 1 binding VHH-Fc fusion proteins
articles.rationale: Monovalent TfR1 VHH-Fc oligonucleotide shuttle identifying affinity, DAR and conjugation site as determinants; no figures in abstract.

articles.title: CA-IV-directed small-molecule shuttle enables targeted brain delivery of biologics.
articles.rationale: CA-IV small-molecule shuttle is a new brain-enriched route with 7-day parenchymal retention; no baseline comparator number.

articles.title: Efficient brain delivery and sustained retention of antibodies via dual targeting of blood-brain barrier and intra-brain proteins.
articles.rationale: Dual BBB plus intra-brain-protein antibody gives higher Cmax and 4-month retention than either arm; no fold stated.

articles.title: Neutral Backbone Modifications Enhance the Pharmacokinetics and Biodistribution of Antibody-Oligonucleotide Conjugates with High Drug-to-Antibody Ratios.
articles.rationale: Neutral siRNA backbone chemistry rescues PK of DAR2 TfR1 AOCs; loading-relevant fix, no numbers in abstract.

articles.title: VyPAL2 peptide asparaginyl ligase enables versatile workflows for radiolabeling single-domain antibody-based theranostics.
articles.rationale: VyPAL2 is new site-specific sdAb conjugation with renal retention 35.5 vs 105.5 %IA/g, but this is off-target reduction, not more delivered cargo.

articles.title: Identification of a Novel Linker Enabling the Bioconjugation of a Cyclic Dinucleotide for the STING Antibody-Drug Conjugate TAK-500.
articles.rationale: Linker-payload chemistry for a STING ADC at stochastic DAR 4 with no uptake or delivery comparison.

articles.title: The Impact of Cognate Antigen Binding on the FcRn-mediated Transcytosis and Recycling of Monoclonal Antibodies.
articles.rationale: Mechanistic FcRn transcytosis/recycling data showing antigen reduces transport; no new delivery construct.

articles.title: Polyphenol-Mediated Antibody Functionalization of Titanium Peroxide Nanoparticles for Cancer Cell Targeting.
articles.rationale: Polyphenol antibody coating raised NP internalization 2.4-6.5-fold in vitro and tumor accumulation ~2-fold in vivo versus unmodified NPs.

articles.title: Nanobody-Based Bioconjugates as Potent and Broadly Active Inhibitors of HIV Entry.
articles.rationale: Nanobody-fusion inhibitor conjugates reach 10,000-fold antiviral potency, a function readout rather than delivered cargo.

articles.title: An Antibody-Oligonucleotide Conjugate for Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1.
articles.rationale: Phase 1-2 clinical readout of an established TfR1 AOC platform in a new indication; limited mechanism.

articles.title: Charge-driven lipid nanoparticle encapsulation of enzymes for enhanced ERT with reduced immunogenicity.
articles.rationale: 15-fold intracellular enzyme activity and 100 enzymes per LNP, but non-antibody LNP carrier; off-modality for the thesis.

articles.title: Engineering BiTE-inspired IPSC-exosomes to potentiate CAR-T cell therapy against lung cancer.
articles.rationale: scFv-exosome uptake 79.3% vs 47.9% liposomes compares carrier types and the paper is immunomodulation-centred.

articles.title: An antibody-drug conjugate designed through clone and isotype selection restricts the growth of CSPG4-expressing triple-negative breast cancer.
articles.rationale: Clone and isotype internalization comparison with DAR 8 DXd; conventional ADC optimization, no quantified delivery.

articles.title: Efficacy of a site-specific anti-Nectin-4 antibody-drug conjugate against Nectin-4-positive triple-negative breast cancer models.
articles.rationale: PODS cysteine ADC at DAR 2.2 with in vitro potency inferior to enfortumab vedotin; no delivery gain.

articles.title: Exatecan Payload-Based Antibody-Drug Conjugates with a Short Hydrophilic Cleavable Linker.
articles.rationale: Novel short hydrophilic glucuronic spacer enables DAR 8 exatecan ADC with better plasma stability; same standard as other hydrophilic-linker DAR papers.

articles.title: De novo masking domains that gate TNF-family ligand assembly and activity
articles.rationale: De novo masks for TNF-family ligand fusions; ~30-fold killing is function, no cargo-amount data.

articles.title: Development of a DUX4-targeting antibody oligonucleotide conjugate as a therapy for FSHD.
articles.rationale: Established TfR1 AOC platform applied to FSHD; ~75% gene reduction is a pharmacodynamic readout.

articles.title: Spatiotemporal Profiling of Intratumoral Free Payload Distribution via MALDI Imaging Mass Spectrometry: Implications for Drug-to-Antibody Ratio Optimization in Antibody-Drug Conjugates.
articles.rationale: MALDI imaging shows DAR4 and DAR8 give equal intratumoral free payload; mechanistic DAR insight, no delivery gain.

articles.title: Hydrogel confinement enables subcutaneous delivery of vesicant antibody-drug conjugates
articles.rationale: Hydrogel depot SC bioavailability (78%) is formulation, not loading or targeting; no antibody-specific delivery mechanism.

articles.title: Brain shuttle target expression levels vary by individual, not by brain region, disease, age, or sex
articles.rationale: Human brain shuttle target expression stable across groups but variable between individuals; usable design implication only.

articles.title: A Syndecan-Based Genetic Approach to Coat the Surface of Small Extracellular Vesicles With Nanobodies.
articles.rationale: Genetic nanobody coating of ~20% of sEVs with modest in vitro uptake gain; no baseline fold and no in vivo data.

articles.title: A Nanobody-LNP Platform for Targeting and Relicensing Dendritic Cells for Potent Cancer Immunotherapy.
articles.rationale: Nanobody-LNP for a new DC target with conventional decoration; 93% internalization has no comparator.

articles.title: Bispecific antibody-drug conjugates targeting EGFR and LGR5 exert potent antitumor activity in colorectal cancer models
articles.rationale: Bispecific ADC potency gain (100-1000-fold) is function readout; internalization gain not quantified.

articles.title: Generation of DAR1 Glycosite-Specific Antibody-Drug Conjugates Using DisacLink Technology.
articles.rationale: DAR1 extension of the existing DisacLink glycosite platform; no delivery readout.

articles.title: Engineering Lipid Nanoparticles through Integrated Compositional and Ligand Targeting Enhances β Cell-Directed RNA Delivery.
articles.rationale: 148-fold gain is from LNP composition versus Moderna LNP, not antibody; antibody conjugation added >2-fold expression only.

articles.title: FcBP-HFQ lipid-mediated trastuzumab modification of mRNA-loaded lipid nanoparticles enhances delivery to HER2-expressing cancer cells.
articles.rationale: Over 100-fold greater cellular association than unmodified LNPs, but an extension of the authors' existing FcBP platform, so held at 4.

articles.title: Therapeutic targeting of folate receptor alpha (FRα) by antibody-polymer-drug conjugate in testicular germ cell tumors.
articles.rationale: Antibody-polymer conjugate at DAR ~23 with 210-fold lower IC50 than MIRV and survival benefit; high-loading concrete, though platform is established.

articles.title: Cetuximab-loaded self-assembled polymeric nanoparticles for the integrin-targeted therapy of glioblastoma.
articles.rationale: Integrin-targeted chitosan nanoparticles encapsulating cetuximab; no antibody-specific delivery insight.

articles.title: GPCR antagonism via rewiring of receptor trafficking and degradation.
articles.rationale: TfR1-GPCR degrader chimeras scored by receptor downregulation potency; degrader readout, not delivered cargo.

articles.title: Computational framework-guided engineering of microbial transglutaminase enables site-specific conjugation of Trastuzumab.
articles.rationale: Engineered MTGase shows 3.6-fold enzyme activity, an enzyme-kinetics figure with no payload or delivery validation.

articles.title: A bispecific antibody targeting a membrane-proximal ASGPR1 region promotes TNF-α recruitment and uptake
articles.rationale: ASGPR1 bispecific TNF-alpha clearance (~60% in 90 min) is in vitro mechanistic starting point.

articles.title: Intracellular Delivery of Full-Length Antibodies via Poly-l-lysine-Coated PEG-PLGA Polymersomes Enables Noninvasive Pulmonary Immunotherapy.
articles.rationale: PLL-coated polymersomes raise antibody encapsulation to ~80%; generic nanocarrier without antibody-specific insight.

articles.title: Internalization-Dependent EGFR-Targeted Photoactivation by Cetuximab-I21 Conjugates.
articles.rationale: DAR 8 photosensitizer conjugate with conventional chemistry and a new payload; no loading/uptake comparator.
